name: cabin
description: A hand-written bilingual (English + Finnish) group about booking a cabin, splitting costs and a club meeting. Written to exercise recall, a changed decision, cross-session reasoning and abstention.

text: Should we book a cabin for the weekend of 20 September?
Yes. Rovaniemi one or the Kuusamo one?
Kuusamo. Decided then, Mikko books Kuusamo for 20-21 September.
Hyvä. Paljonko se maksaa per henki?
240 euroa yhteensä, eli 60 euroa per henki neljälle.
Who is bringing the sauna stove wood?
I have half a cubic metre in the garage, I will bring it.
Great. Sara brings the food then, and Juha brings the drinks.
Kerhon kokous on 14. toukokuuta kello 18 kirjastolla.
Merkitty kalenteriin.
Korjaus: kokous siirtyi 21. toukokuuta, sama kello ja paikka.
Bad news: I cannot book the cabin after all, work trip. Sara, can you?
Yes, I booked it just now. Same cabin, same dates, confirmation 4711.
Thanks Sara. So Sara books Kuusamo for 20-21 September, not Mikko.
Muistutus: maksakaa 60 euroa Saralle ennen syyskuuta.
Which cabin did we pick?
Who books the cabin?
expected: Sara books it; Mikko could not, so she took over on 2 July 2026.

text: Kuka tuo saunapuut?
expected: Mikko brings the sauna wood, half a cubic metre from his garage.

text: Paljonko mökki maksaa per henki?
expected: 60 euroa per henki, yhteensä 240 euroa neljälle.

text: When is the club meeting?
expected: 21 May 2026 at 18:00 at the library; it was moved from 14 May.

text: Who is bringing the food and who the drinks?
expected: Sara brings the food, Juha brings the drinks.
